query:
SELECT cs.id as slot_id, cs.sold, cs.saleId, cs.consultationDate, cs.consultationTime,
       s.id as sale_id_in_sales, s.clientName, s.clientPhone, s.clientBirthDate, s.sellerId,
       u.displayName as seller_name, u.username
FROM consultation_slots cs
LEFT JOIN sales s ON cs.saleId = s.id
LEFT JOIN users u ON s.sellerId = u.id
WHERE cs.sold = true
LIMIT 10;
